decisive_items: Wedge biopsy of submammary plaque showed:  - Pseudoepitheliomatous epidermal hyperplasia  - Focal superficial erosion  - Superficial and deep granulomatous inflammatory infiltrate  - Well-formed, nonnecrotizing granulomas  - Langhans-type multinucleated giant cells  - Epithelioid histiocytes  - Lymphoplasmacytic inflammatory cuff

Linear moist, eroded, exophytic, condyloma-like plaques present in:- Bilateral submammary folds- Intergluteal cleft- Under the abdominal apron- Ulcers of the bilateral genitocrural folds- Vulvar edema
response.rationale: The patient's histopathology results and clinical presentation are most consistent with granulomatous dermatitis, although the clinical presentation also shares features with hidradenitis suppurativa.

rejected.why: The patient's colonoscopy results were unremarkable, which does not support a diagnosis of Crohn's disease.
